Create a stylized elven courtyard in a rocky valley filled with woodland, organized around a circular stone plaza. Light the scene with soft daylight. On opposing sides of the central plaza, set two round elven homes with domed roofs, decorative roof ornaments, and arched entryways. Position a stone altar in the middle of the plaza and place a group of blue crystals on the altar. Provide a broad stone staircase at the front of the plaza, with an ornamental arch surrounding the staircase entrance. Run railings beside the staircase and around the plaza's outer edges, keeping the approach open. Place benches around the plaza and lanterns alongside the approach. Enclose the courtyard with groups of large trees and uneven rocks behind the homes. Around the tree bases, distribute smaller rocks, grass, flowers, and mushrooms. Let ivy cover selected building walls. Preserve a clear passage between the staircase and the altar, and surround the pale stone architecture with lush green plants.
